title: CVE-2026-119977: When Updating WordPress Becomes the Vulnerability
content_md: During my security research at Picus Security, I discovered a race condition in the WordPress core updater that can allow an unauthenticated attacker to replace a site’s live wp-config.php during a core update. The vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1) and was fixed in WordPress 7.1.4. On November 3, 2026, CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, confirming that it is being actively exploited in the wild.
